title: Detect stuck resource queues and account for every queue removal
description: Add machine-level non-AI queue/lease health monitoring: waiting work with unused declared slots, missing tickets, premature runners and stale leases. Report process ownership and apply only narrowly approved safe recovery; never kill a browser based on name or assume a stopped runner implies stopped descendants. Existing browser capacity is project-defined, not fixed at two.
acceptanceCriteria: Queued work losing its slot is durably notified and stops instead of silently blocking the queue
Every withdraw/cancel/recovery has an audited reason and actor
Watchdog identifies mismatched live executor/lease without killing unrelated or unconfirmed processes
